notes.title: Version 4.7 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Major Benefit: 7-Day Login Event

To thank all players for your love and support, we’re launching a **limited-time 7-Day Login Event** for everyone!
After the 4.7 update goes live, log in for 7 consecutive days to claim exciting rewards each day, including **choose-1-of-3 spells, an advanced spell chest, an exclusive spell skin**, and a total value of up to **60,000 gold**!

---

  New Spells

**Crow Illusion**
  A defensive spell that grants brief invincibility when the player takes damage.

**Plague Rat**
  Summons a hard-to-hit rat carrying a deadly virus. Any unit it infects will die within seconds.

**Achillie’s Sword**
  Starts as a small and unremarkable blade but can evolve into multiple powerful forms through upgrades.

---

New Spell Skins

**Water Element – Water’s Abhorrence**
**Machine Gun Spell – AK47**
**God’s Wrath – True Dragon Form**

---

Spell Adjustments

**Hurricane (Rebalanc)**

* Healing effect removed
* Now removes enemy drawn spell patterns immediately upon casting

**Ruyi Stick (Nerf)**

* Mana will not regenerate naturally while the spell is active
* Duration reduced from 60s to 50s

---

 2v2 Balance Changes

* Defense tower attack speed reduced
* Increases the early-game advantage impact on match outcomes

notes.title: Halloween Haunt: War of Wizards Update!
notes.content:
New Spell: Grim Reaper’s Pact
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858682/ce3de07640295b04b646f5bdfdc629c43f428437.png
Spells Description
Embrace the darkness with this powerful new spell! By signing a pact with death, the caster sacrifices a portion of their health to summon the Grim Reaper onto the battlefield. With a terrifying aura, the Reaper slowly drifts toward an enemy, wielding a massive scythe that can deal up to 95% of their current health in damage! This spell is a high-stakes gamble—use it wisely, as it significantly lowers your own health, but if executed perfectly, it can obliterate foes in a single, devastating strike.

Prepare to delve into the ultimate Halloween experience and dominate your enemies like never before!

notes.title: Version 3.7.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
New Spell:

Frying Pan: The legendary frying pan, forged by Hera herself, Zeus’s wife, used to discipline Zeus. When you wield this frying pan, you become an invincible shield bearer. Hold it steady, and all flying projectiles will helplessly fall before you. Swing it, and the mighty force will deflect projectiles back, turning them into the enemy’s nightmare. Moreover, this magical frying pan can bat away ghost,pigman and mosquitoes. Once hit, they will be stunned for a full 15 seconds and 500 damage, rendered completely powerless!

Skill Adjustments:

Spectral Quartet of the Abyss (Nerf)

 Cooldown increased from 90 seconds to 120 seconds
 Mana cost increased from 300 to 400
 Pigman’s health doubled
 Other ghosts' health reduced by 500


Purification (Nerf)
Cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds

Ichor Rain (Nerf)
Cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds

Tornado (Buff)
Number of damage ticks increased from 8 to 12

Natural Healing Mechanism Re-enabled

Bug Fixes:


 Fixed the bug where other players were not visible.
 Fixed the bug where the game would disconnect at the end.

notes.title: Version 3.6 Announcement
notes.content:
1. New TASK System: Introducing daily sign-in and daily first-win tasks.

2. Weekly Free Spell System: Each week, 7 free spells will be available for players to try out.

3. AFK Compensation Mechanism:
If a teammate is AFK or detected as inactive for more than 3 minutes, no points will be deducted for losing the match, and winning the match will grant extra points.

Players who are AFK or engage in passive gameplay will not receive victory points.

4. Network Performance Optimization: Improved the network performance to reduce occurrences of game stuttering.

notes.title: War of Wizards: New Spells & Wands Released
notes.content:
Prepare yourselves for an epic update that will elevate War of Wizards to new heights! On August 12th, we're introducing a major update, packed with innovative features and strategic enhancements, including a formidable new spell and a collection of visually stunning wands.

Unleash the Spectral Abyssal Quartet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858682/fcb9169c07914f487f01c8daad0287a80c21d427.png
Harness the dark powers of the nether with the Spectral Abyssal Quartet, a game-changing spell that will revolutionize your battle strategies. When you summon the Caskets of the Nether, four spectral caskets emerge, each enshrining an accursed spirit from the infernal realms. These ghastly sarcophagi home in on their living targets, releasing the Specters of Damnation, each wielding a unique and formidable power:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858682/0cc063e7b6649bd724d67d2d527efd157d08a2e9.png
Pumpkin Wraith: Creeps up to its victim, gouging out their eyes and rendering them blind and helpless, unable to see your actions or attacks.
Slaughter Swine: A butcher with a cleaver in hand, hacks away at enemies, dealing massive damage.
Spell Devourer: Latches onto enemies, sucking the very essence of their mana, leaving them powerless and unable to cast spells.
Cursebound Scare: A sinister scarecrow that silences opponents by sealing their mouths shut, preventing any spellcasting or basic attacks.
With the Abyssal Quartet, you’ll dominate your enemies with a deadly combination of force, energy siphoning, spell suppression, and vision obscuration. This spell is set to change the dynamics of battle, offering new strategies for both seasoned and novice wizards alike.

New Wands: Visual Masterpieces Await

We're also thrilled to introduce four new wands:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858682/eca5de6f7eef5c3022ddf11267f4bf8c9c44d372.png
Nature’s Power
Nether Spirit
Blood Moon Spike
Dragonfire Wrath
These wands come with stunning visual effects that will make your wizard stand out in any battle. Please note that while these wands are visually captivating, they do not provide any attack bonuses.

Join the Battle on August 12th

Mark your calendars for  and dive into the latest chapter in the epic saga of War of Wizards. Experience the thrilling power of the Abyssal Quartet and equip yourself with the new wands. Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you in the game!
